notes: Tuition: the MATE fee table gives 2300 Euro for the BSc in Tourism and Catering (Gyöngyös, full-time, English) as the most recent entry (the same row also shows 350 000 Ft for earlier semesters), so the EUR amount is the latest self-financed fee for this programme/location; the page does not specify the payment period. applicationChannel: the pages name only the University's own institutional admission procedure (no platform such as Stipendium Hungaricum is named for applying), so hu-university-direct. Documents: the requirement list names only 'High School leaving certificate' plus CV and motivation letter; no quote requires translation, so translationRequired is null.

note.fr: Un entretien en ligne de 20 à 30 minutes est obligatoire ; l'admission repose sur les résultats antérieurs (20 pts), le CV et la lettre de motivation (20 pts) et l'entretien (60 pts).
note.en: A 20-30 minute online interview is required; admission is based on previous results (20 pts), CV and motivation letter (20 pts) and the interview (60 pts).

evidence.quote: The admission procedure consits of the following parts: 20-30 minutes long online interview.
